chunks: We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ibrahim ibn Ishaq, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman al-Daylami, from his father, that he said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
Do not abandon the standing during the night, for indeed, the defrauded is the one who is defrauded from the standing during the night.

key_terms.الْمَغْبُونَ: The defrauded / The one who suffers loss
key_terms.قِيَامَ اللَّيْلِ: Night prayer / Standing in prayer during the night

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of not abandoning night prayer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the neglect of Qiyam al-Layl as the primary cause of spiritual loss, framing it as the definitive mark of the 'defrauded' (al-maghboon). This highlights the Shia emphasis on night worship as a critical means of purifying the soul and securing divine favor, distinguishing those who actively seek closeness to Allah from those who are left behind in their spiritual journey.
